item.title: Welterweight Titles Tighten Around Garcia vs Haney II as Options Narrow
item.description: The welterweight division has four recognized champions, but the belts are moving in separate directions, and the matchups are narrowing by elimination, not negotiation. Ryan Garcia holds the WBC title at 147 pounds, with rival Devin Haney owning the WBO belt.
